verdict.rationale: Baseten documents an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint for Model APIs. Its docs show swapping it in by changing only `base_url`, for example with LangChain's `ChatOpenAI`, and they document function calling and streaming. Baseten Switch and slug routing also let agents move requests to and from Anthropic, OpenAI, or external models. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that switching mid-workflow needs no code changes, a documented list of which OpenAI parameters are fully supported, clarity on whether dedicated deployments share the same compatible surface, and clarity on whether 'in beta' covers Chat Completions or only the Anthropic Messages API.
